name: timeharbor
description: A local-first Firefox extension for mindful browsing, time limits and healthy breaks.

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir outputs --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chromium: npm run build:chromium && web-ext build --source-dir dist-chromium --artifacts-dir outputs --filename timeharbor-chromium-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests public scripts/*.mjs scripts/firefox-harness.js server/*.mjs
